Order No. 3 Dated - 17.10.2023 Heard the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Daltonganj (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 5 of 2023 instituted under Sections 406, 420, 498A, 504, 506 & 120 B of the Indian Penal Code, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privileges of anticipatory bail.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner being the husband of the informant has treated the informant cruelty in connection with demand of dowry.

Drawing the attention of the court to the supplementary affidavit, it is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner has already paid Rs. 2,50,000/- to the informant and undertakes to pay for the amount of Rs. 3,50,000/- to the informant and is ready and willing to cooperate the investigation of the case.
It is next submitted that the case has been instituted because of marital discord between the parties.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned A.P.P. for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.
Considering the submissions of the counsels and the fact as discussed above, I am of the opinion that it is a fit case where the above- named petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Hence, in the event of his arrest or surrender within a period of eight weeks from the date of this order, he shall be released on bail on depositing a demand draft of Rs. 3,50,000/- drawn in favour of informant without prejudice to his defence in this case and on furnishing bail bond of Rehan Ahmad vs The State Of Jharkhand on 17 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76632735/
1 Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Palamau at Daltonganj in connection with Daltonganj (Mahila) P.S.
Case No. 5 of 2023 with the condition that the petitioner will cooperate with the investigation of the case and appear before the Investigating Officer as and when noticed by him and will furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card in the court below with the undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions laid down under section 438 (2) Cr. P.C.

the court below is directed to issue notice to the informant and hand over the said demand draft to him, after proper identification and the same shall be adjusted towards the amount of maintenance or one time settlement between the parties, if any, payable to the informant.
